ctx.x: That I would never have to run anymore. So now, let’s see I’m on the west side. Then came Charles and Lonnie and oh, I can’t think of the boy’s name. But I’ve been talking about him because he’s been sick. The piano player. Let’s see most of the musicians, they came through me, you know.
And who – who affected you? Who were some of the older musicians who affected you and changed your life?
